title: Cosmic Mother and Child
description: A silhouetted mother and child sit embraced in a starry cosmic scene. The mother holds a glowing heart-shaped nebula that drips luminous paint, surrounded by vibrant red and purple flowers blooming from her body against a meteor-filled night sky.
prompt: A silhouetted mother hugging her child from behind, both made of starry night sky, holding a large glowing heart-shaped galaxy that drips luminous pink and purple paint downwards. Vibrant red and purple bioluminescent flowers grow around and from her body, dramatic golden and pink meteor shower and nebula streaks across the dark cosmic background, magical surreal fantasy style.
